games.name: UPDATE! Dynamic Ship Simulator III
games.desc:
Update 50 sets sail with something for everyone! Live it up aboard Superyacht Amaryllis, ride high seas on the Azerbaijan-class RO-PAX, or go back in time on the Julia Swain Paddlesteamer. Craving speed? Race the 50' & 42' Powerboats, 18' Drag Boat, or the sleek Stinger 390x. Also joining the fleet: the massive 5400 Series container ship and the Halifax-class frigate. Plus new terminals & marina at Nexo, terminal & shipyard at Ushuaia, shipyard at Ronne!

Welcome to the immense world of Dynamic Ship Simulator III! In this game, you can sail anything from a jetski all the way up to a massive Arctic-class LNG carrier. Engage in player-vs-player combat in your Visby-class Corvette, cruise around in your motorboat or transport cars in your European-class ferry. Be sure to watch for updates!

games.name: 👑STRONGEST PUNCH SIMULATOR
games.desc:
Are you ready to become the strongest of them all?

GUIDE
Break Through Walls --> Reach World Borders --> Teleport To Higher Worlds --> - Collect Power Ups Hidden Behind The Walls --> Feed Your Mythical Pets And Evolve Them --> Become Stronger --> Do You Desire To Protect Or Destroy, Take Your Sides!

FAQ
- Experiencing lag? Turn on ‘Fast Mode’ in settings
- Punch terrain walls to gain double the amount of power!
- Become stronger to create bigger punch explosions!
- Train in higher worlds to gain more power!
- Higher worlds have denser terrains causing your area of explosion to be reduced!
- Upgrade Punch Multiplier to train faster!
- Damage done to stronger heroes will reflect back upon yourself!
- Choose to attack only good/bad heroes in settings to prevent unwanted reputation losses!
